usedFor: Judge.me holds product reviews, and Calendly sets up a follow-up call with “Create One-Time Meeting” for each new one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Review” in Judge.me, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A fresh review is a reason to talk to the customer, so a meeting opens for just that person.

watchOut: Many Judge.me triggers send widget updates, so choose “New Review” and not a widget event, or meetings multiply.
